hints.title: Character Boundary Invariant
hints.text: Determine the minimum bounding interval for every character present in the string.

hints.title: Minimal Self-Contained Expansion
hints.text: A substring is special if every character inside it appears exclusively within that substring. Expand each interval until all included characters are self-contained.

hints.title: Greedy Interval Scheduling
hints.text: Discard the entire string as a candidate interval unless k is zero. Form the valid non-overlapping intervals greedily by sorting according to end boundaries.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Locates bounds and expands valid intervals followed by interval scheduling.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) substrings causes time limit issues.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing first and last occurrences bounds the search to at most 26 candidate intervals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate minimal valid intervals containing all instances of their constituent characters and apply interval scheduling.
